summary: Yunlong Chen, 55, of China, traveling alone on a ski vacation; last seen Thursday Feb 28, 2019 at the Vail Transportation Center (~8:15-9 a.m.), ski pass scanned at Gondola One; never returned; skeletal remains found in Vail's back bowls during a multi-agency recovery search on Saturday 2019-08-17, with personal items consistent with the family's description
location: Vail Mountain back bowls (in-bounds), Vail Mountain
responding_agency: Eagle County Sheriff's Office; Vail Mountain Rescue Group; Vail Ski Patrol (mutual aid on Aug-17 recovery: El Paso County SAR, Mesa County SAR, Chaffee County SAR, Summit County SAR, Boulder Rescue Squad)
notes: Reported missing ~2019-03-10 after family realized he had not returned home to China; ski patrol and instructors conducted daily searches through the season; remains recovery was a collaborative search by VMRG, Vail Ski Patrol, ECSO, El Paso/Mesa/Chaffee/Summit County SAR teams, Boulder Rescue Squad, and others
